overview.description: The GMO Ultra-Short Income ETF (GMOC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund actively manages a portfolio composed of US investment-grade fixed-income securities with maturities of less than one year. The fund aims to generate current income while maintaining capital preservation. GMOC was launched on Oct 27, 2025 and is issued by GMO.
